title: SCHC fragmentation never invoked on oversized encapsulated datagrams (root TX errors instead)
description: Spec 05-routing.md §8.9 (R-05-065): 'After encapsulation and SCHC compression, datagrams larger than one LoRa frame MUST use SCHC fragmentation as specified in Section 5.' Divergent in effect: the fragmentation engine exists and is vector-tested (rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs, tests lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation_vectors.rs + reassembly_state_machine.rs, vectors schc_fragmentation.json/schc_fragment.json) but the root encapsulation TX path never invokes it — rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs:484-522 send_l2_payload_to returns TxError::FrameEncode when compressed payload exceeds MAX_EXTENDED_SCHC_SIZE(185)+1; gateway transmit_ipv6_wire likewise. No C integration. Fix: wire FragmentationPolicy into the encapsulated-datagram TX path.
